relationship.support_rule: closed contact can carry static tangential support only while the demanded force direction remains within the authored friction cone; closed topology alone never grants support
relationship.force_rule: normal preload establishes eligibility; the visible demand/resultant direction sweeps from cone center to boundary; outside demand clamps available friction and initiates slide while contact remains closed
relationship.topology_rule: TOUCH remains closed through INSIDE -> BOUNDARY -> OUTSIDE_CLAMPED/SLIDE -> REENTER -> RESTICK; topology opens only after tangential and then normal load reach zero
relationship.release_rule: tangential unload -> normal unload -> zero-load touch -> real release gap
relationship.novelty_vs_contact016: Contact016 taught traction hysteresis through fixed-patch dwell, skid and restick. Contact025 instead makes force-vector directional admissibility itself visible: a result/demand vector sweeps through a drawn friction cone, crosses its boundary before slip, clamps during slip, and re-enters before restick.

keys.name: SEPARATE_READ
keys.causal_role: establish ground ownership and a real wall gap before any contact eligibility
keys.root_com_note: root and COM stack over ground; wall carries nothing

keys.name: ELIGIBILITY_APPROACH
keys.causal_role: advance COM toward wall while preserving negative space
keys.root_com_note: COM commits before palm closure; no wall authority yet

keys.name: TOUCH_ZERO
keys.causal_role: close palm-wall topology at zero force without granting support
keys.root_com_note: touch exists but neither normal nor tangential force exists

keys.name: NORMAL_PRELOAD
keys.causal_role: earn friction eligibility by normal compression before tangential demand
keys.root_com_note: shoulder compresses toward fixed palm; rear foot counters wall normal

keys.name: CONE_CENTER_STICK
keys.causal_role: hold contact fixed with resultant deep inside the friction cone
keys.root_com_note: fixed palm and sinking pelvis make wall-assisted support visible while force direction is safely admissible

keys.name: CONE_SWEEP_STICK
keys.causal_role: rotate tangential demand toward cone edge while the patch remains fixed
keys.root_com_note: palm stays at one coordinate while COM drops and the visible reaction vector banks upward inside the cone

keys.name: BOUNDARY_HOLD
keys.causal_role: arrive at the authored friction-cone boundary without slipping yet
keys.root_com_note: fixed patch, deep counterlean and boundary-aligned reaction hold for a beat before loss of static authority

keys.name: OUTSIDE_DEMAND_SLIP_ONSET
keys.causal_role: push demand beyond the cone; clamp friction and begin slide without opening contact
keys.root_com_note: demand marker exits the cone while actual reaction clamps; hand y changes for the first time and root overruns

keys.name: SLIDE_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: continue closed-contact slide with body momentum outrunning reduced tangential authority
keys.root_com_note: palm migrates three more rows; torso remains behind and free arm trails high

keys.name: DEMAND_REENTERS_CONE
keys.causal_role: reduce shear demand back inside the cone while contact is still sliding
keys.root_com_note: front catch arrests root while palm completes one final downward cell; admissibility returns before restick

keys.name: RESTICK_DISPLACED
keys.causal_role: re-establish static support only after demand has re-entered the cone
keys.root_com_note: new lower palm coordinate stays fixed while body rebounds up-left, proving a new anchor rather than reset

keys.name: TANGENTIAL_UNLOAD_ZERO
keys.causal_role: remove wall shear while preserving normal closure
keys.root_com_note: ground has retaken the root; palm still presses but carries no tangential support

keys.name: NORMAL_UNLOAD_ZERO
keys.causal_role: return normal load to zero while preserving one beat of contact
keys.root_com_note: both force components are zero while topology is still closed

keys.name: RELEASE_GAP
keys.causal_role: open topology only after force has fully unloaded
keys.root_com_note: real gap opens; torso recoils first while the old contact arm remains low

keys.name: COUNTER_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: pay stored lean and slip debt with an opposite-body overshoot and split clocks
keys.root_com_note: root overshoots left; contact arm lags low while free arm stays high, opening deliberate negative space

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: settle at a new address with asymmetry and release gap preserved
keys.root_com_note: settle remains left of the pre-contact load address with asymmetric arms; no idle reset
